file_roles.evidence: Call site changed from pbwm.lock(MODE_X) to pbwm.lock(nullptr, MODE_X) after the one-arg overload was removed.
GlobalLock constructor called `_pbwm.lock(opCtx, MODE_IS)` ignoring the deadline; diff passes `deadline`, and ResourceLock::lock now forwards it to _locker->lock(...).
Declaration gains `Date_t deadline = Date_t::max()` and drops the uninterruptible overload; interface change enabling the .cpp fix.

rationale: The report says the PBWM acquisition in the GlobalLock constructor ignores the passed deadline and can hang. The .cpp changes pass the deadline through GlobalLock and ResourceLock::lock. The header and sleep command change only to match the new signature.
notes: Header could be argued causal because ResourceLock::lock had no deadline parameter; I kept it as interface plumbing.
